designs.title: Rainbows
designs.description: A little color for every day.

collections.title: Genesis
collections.heading: Start at the beginning.
collections.description: Creation, trust, and God’s promises. The same eight verses in every design, with a reference on the front and the full verse on the back.
collections.firstVerse: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.
collections.context: Genesis 50:20 describes God bringing good from Joseph’s suffering. It does not excuse harm or ask a child to remain unsafe. Encourage children to tell a trusted adult if someone hurts them.

collections.title: Spiritual Armor
collections.heading: Stand strong in God’s love.
collections.description: Eight complete verses from Ephesians 6 help children remember God's strength, truth, peace, faith, salvation, word, and prayer.
collections.firstVerse: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of his might.
collections.context: Read Ephesians 6:10–18 together. God’s armor is a picture of spiritual faithfulness, never a reason to fight people.
collections.guideDescription: Includes three parent-guide pages, the holder, two deliberate blank pages, and the two-page alignment test.

collections.title: Fruit of the Spirit
collections.heading: Grow in love, day by day.
collections.description: Eight complete verses help families learn all nine qualities of the fruit of the Spirit and practice love in daily life.
collections.firstVerse: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,
collections.context: Read cards 1 and 2 together: Galatians 5:22–23 includes all nine qualities. WEB Classic uses “faith,” with the footnote “or, faithfulness.”
collections.guideDescription: Includes three parent-guide pages, the holder, two deliberate blank pages, and the two-page alignment test.

collections.title: Exodus
collections.heading: A journey of faith.
collections.description: Eight selected Exodus verses introduce God's call to Moses, Israel's rescue, worship, covenant, and daily faithfulness.
collections.firstVerse: God said to Moses, “I AM WHO I AM,” and he said, “You shall tell the children of Israel this: ‘I AM has sent me to you.’ ”
collections.context: Eight selected memory verses from Exodus, not a complete Ten Commandments set.
collections.guideDescription: Includes three parent-guide pages, the holder, two deliberate blank pages, and the two-page alignment test.
